mapper.sql: select cart_id, account_id, product_id, sku_id, quantity, del_flag, create_time, update_time from mall_cart

select mc.cart_id as cartId, mc.account_id as accountId, mc.product_id as productId, mc.sku_id as skuId, mc.quantity as quantity, mc.del_flag as delFlag, mc.create_time as createTime, mc.update_time as updateTime from mall_cart mc
mapper.select: select mc.cart_id as cartId, mc.account_id as accountId, mc.product_id as productId, mc.sku_id as skuId, mc.quantity as quantity, mc.del_flag as delFlag, mc.create_time as createTime, mc.update_time as updateTime from mall_cart mc where mc.del_flag = 0 and mc.cart_id = #{cartId} limit 1

select mc.cart_id as cartId, mc.account_id as accountId, mc.product_id as productId, mp.product_name as productName, mc.sku_id as skuId, mps.sku_name as skuName, mps.sale_price as salePrice, mc.quantity as quantity, (mps.sale_price * mc.quantity) as subtotal from mall_cart mc inner join mall_product mp on mc.product_id = mp.product_id and mp.del_flag = 0 inner join mall_product_sku mps on mc.sku_id = mps.sku_id and mps.del_flag = 0 where mc.del_flag = 0 and mc.account_id = #{accountId} order by mc.cart_id desc
